Mahjong Lines

Mahjong Lines is an engaging logic puzzle game in the mahjong connect genre, where you need to find and connect pairs of matching tiles using simple and intuitive rules.

Enjoy classic mahjong gameplay in a comfortable format: all tiles are placed on a single level, and your goal is to clear the boa

The rules of Mahjong Lines are simple and intuitive:

🀄Tap on two identical tiles.

🀄Tiles can be removed if a path of no more than three straight lines can be built between them.

🀄The connecting line may pass only through empty cells.

🀄The connected pair disappears from the board.

🀄To complete a level, you need to remove all tiles.

🀄Use hints if you can’t find available moves and clear the board step by step, carefully planning each connection.

Nonogram

Nonogram is a captivating picture cross puzzle with a vast collection of griddlers.
Challenge your mind with this easy-to-play logic puzzle, and become a real Nonogram master!
Join nonogram puzzle players all around the world, use logic to reveal pixel art pictures, and have fun with this picture

The Goal:
- Fill in the correct squares to form a picture, using only the number clues - no guessing.

Understanding the Clues:
- Numbers appear at the top of each column and left of each row.
- Each number tells you how many consecutive filled squares appear in that row or column.
- Multiple numbers mean multiple groups, with at least one empty square between groups.
Example:
"3 1" means: three filled squares, at least one empty space, then one filled square.

CatDoku

CatDoku is a cozy logic puzzle with cute cats! Place the fluffy heroes on the board following three simple rules: one cat per row and column, one cat per color, and no cats in adjacent cells. Easy rules — but the further you go, the trickier the levels get.

The goal is to place cats on the board so that all three rules are satisfied.

CatDoku Rules:
🐾 1 cat per row and column — exactly one cat in each row and each column.
🐾 1 cat per color — exactly one cat in each colored zone.
🐾 Cats are not adjacent — no two cats can be in neighboring cells, including diagonally.

How to play:

Tap an empty cell to place a cat.
Tap it again to remove it.
Arrange all the cats so that no rule is broken.

How to Play
Place dogs — Double-tap a tile to place a dog. Each row, column, and colored region needs exactly one.

No touching — Dogs can never touch — not even diagonally. Illegal placements are rejected.

Mark exclusions — Single-tap or swipe across empty tiles to exclude them with an X as you deduce.

Use hints — Tap the lightbulb hint for 50 coins — it reveals one forced dog and updates each move.

Win the duel — Solve more boards than your rival before the five-minute timer ends.
